title: こども交通教室をお手伝い！

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hello, little ones! Today we're going to teach you all about traffic rules!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh! Take a good look over there. It looks like those other Umamusume teachers are playing tag. Now look very carefully, okay?

text_block_list.name: Doubtful Child
text_block_list.text: Are you sure they're teachers? They're really small! As small as me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Grr… I ain't dat small!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And I'm trying to become a mature woman, so why am I playing the kid role?! This is lame!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I do want some answers from the casting department… but remember, this is for the kiddos. We need to tough it out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm over here! Ehehe, you're no match for my evasive maneuvers!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-wait… Oh, no! Watch out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Rrrraaagh! Get outta da way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear! Those two almost crashed into each other! Umamusume can't make sudden stops when they're running, so make sure you don't rush out in front of them!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: But my mom says you should never run at full speed outside!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's right. Umamusume should only go all out in certain places. Yer a good girl for followin' her advice!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Do you all know about Umamusume lanes that roads have? They're special lanes where Umamusume can run at full speed. Be absolutely sure not to stumble into those lanes, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: So we just have to look both ways before we cross an Umamusume lane, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Not only then—a running Umamusume is dangerous wherever she is! Just take a look over there.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer! Hurry it up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eek?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash! Thump, clatter…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What a crazy crash!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! It's all my fault! I… I only ever bring misfortune!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Nah, this is all part of the show. Look, Trainer's totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: See? Even when Umamusume aren't runnin' at full speed, we're still real fast. And we're stronger than we look, ya know. Even if a grown-up stepped out in front of us, they'd get sent flyin'!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Never jump out in front of a running Umamusume. And growing Umamusume must always be aware of their surroundings while running. Make sure you follow these rules!

text_block_list.name: The Children
text_block_list.text: 'Kaaay!
